{{AprilFoolsEnd|date = 2nd of April 2023}} {{AprilFoolsInfobox |image1 = TranslatedModIcon.png |dates = 1 April 2023 – 2 April 2023 |previous_edition = [[April Fools 2022|Randomizer 2022]] |next_edition = [[April Fools 2024 Event|Skibidi 2024]] }} ==Description== '''April Fools 2023''' was the fourth April Fools edition that was added to the game on the 1st of April 2023. ==Changes== The only change in '''April Fools 2023''' is dialogue. The dialogue was translated by the developers multiple times and then applied to the wave dialogue. Not all dialogue was changed, however. This change was done through the [[Translated]] modifier, which was applied to all matches for one day. Below is all dialogue used during '''April Fools 2023''', which does not include lose dialogue, as it was not changed. {{Clear}}
